parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry is_test=true and reside in the same test file 'Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.swift'. Although the Jaccard similarity is high (0.778), the two methods — 'PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.multipleStopCallsAreIdempotent' (line 132) and 'StopBehaviorTests.playAfterStopWorks' (line 234) — have distinct names that encode different behavioral assertions: idempotency of repeated stop calls versus the ability to resume playback after a stop. Structural similarity in test scaffolding (setup, teardown, assertion patterns) is expected and intentional across test cases exercising related stop-playback behavior. Merging or deduplicating them would obscure the distinct behavioral contracts each test is verifying.
